sections.title: New Features
items: Follow the optional Guide through the workbench and read mobile What’s New.
Refresh history requests published release-note text; bundled notes remain available offline.

Supported Wii custom-executable workflows offer cafe2wii and optional IOP2X patching with your own local support files and keys. The finished title requires the supported c2w Aroma plugin and installation to Wii U system memory.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Choose Simple or Advanced, review readiness and save finished build ZIPs with Files.
The iOS edition uses local game, base, runtime, artwork and manual inputs. Release-note metadata and local-network transfers are separate from game-content downloads.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Corrected Wii Trim preparation for supported custom-executable and cafe2wii workflows.
Finished build exports open the Files save dialog reliably.
